summary_claims.claim: Recommendations 23 to 30 under the safe and trusted AI section, including continued AISI support (rec. 23) and funding regulators (rec. 25).
Government response CP 1242 of 13 Jan 2025: the Prime Minister endorses the plan; DSIT to consult on legislation on critical risks of the most powerful models.

scope.note: Mainly a growth and adoption plan with one section on safe and trusted AI; the extractor's scope_note is adequate.

note: GOV.UK page, plan PDF and the government response confirm CP 1241, 13 Jan 2025, 50 recommendations and the response. The two 'Partially agree' answers (recs 13 and 21) and the text-and-data-mining consultation (rec 24) in the notes match the response.
